title: TELOS
author: irpina
description: Mods from the CF card for the Octatrack (OS 1.40C): at the card's first mount it links the .elemod files /ELEKLOADER/MODS/active names into a 2 MB area, sites included, writes /ELEKLOADER/MODS/status.txt, and lists the card's mods in MAIN MENU > MODS (settings-ot 0.2), where YES ticks one after the boot's checks and APPLY saves the set for the next start. Each project saved keeps the list of mods that ran; loading one whose mods differ asks LOAD PROJECT MODS? and YES sets them and restarts. APPLY offers a restart too. [NO] held at the start, or a start after one that didn't get 10 s in, skips the mods once. The design is design/.
